doc.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023

title: Rowe transcribed Hey's horn parts
summary: Rowe jokes that he transcribed Hey's horn parts in 1970s bands; they talk about the tricky rests.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: A bit of delicious irony, I was in a band, many bands in the ‘70s and so forth, and that was my job as well, to listen to the records, and some of the horn parts that I was transcribing were written by you.
And you know it’s the rests — it’s the little sixteenth rests and so forth that are the hardest part.
Yeah, yeah. You know I tried to make it a little tricky here and there and change up things here and there.
It’s almost like some of the things at the time you were doing were almost like writing out clavinet rhythms.
